memory_proof.distinct_from_d: D integrates the delivery deficit alone, without bound, and repays on tau_D (lactate and the sympathetic drive); F relaxes toward the maximum of six signals on its own constants and never exceeds it; F reads no D and D reads no F
memory_proof.monotone_recovery: with S < F, F_next lies strictly between S and F: the memory falls monotonically
memory_proof.no_n: burden_after reads no N, D, lactate or authored level, and nothing writes N
memory_proof.non_negative: F_next = S + (F - S) e^(-dt/tau) is a convex combination of F and S, both in [0, 1]
memory_proof.persists: with S = 0, F_next = F e^(-dt/tau_clear) > 0 for F > 0: zero stress never zeroes the memory at once
memory_proof.prolonged_greater: after a constant S from F = 0, F = S (1 - e^(-t/tau_rise)) rises with the duration t, so a longer insult leaves a larger residual, a larger area F_end x tau_clear and a longer recovery
memory_proof.worsens: with S > F, F_next lies strictly between F and S: acute stress raises the memory

acidemia: the current arterial pH of the respiratory closure; any acidemia lowers it, so an acute hypercapnia also carries some; the maximum keeps the two from adding

hypercapnia: the current PaCO2 of the respiratory closure, read apart from pH
